name: Koinonia Link
author: Randy Breland

sections.description:
Koinonia Link is a streamlined ministry tool designed to help churches manage guest information. It provides a simple “First Impressions” workflow and a secure database for guest details, ensuring you can follow up effectively.

Key Features:
* Guest Database: A dedicated area in your dashboard to view and manage guest profiles.
* Connection Card Shortcode: Use [koinonia_connect] to display a secure registration form on any page.
* Data Ownership: All data is stored in your WordPress database, not on external servers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the koinonia-link folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the shortcode [koinonia_connect] on any page to display the form.
  4. View submissions in the “Koinonia Guests” menu.
sections.faq:
Where is the guest data stored?

It is stored in your local WordPress database as a Custom Post Type.

How do I display the form?

Simply add the shortcode [koinonia_connect] to any Post, Page, or Widget.
